Mode 2 disarms interior zones; exterior zones trigger silent alarms and other alarm zones trigger loud alarms.
Mode 3 is like mode 2, but delayed zones are instant.
Used only when 'All Satel arming modes in alarm panels' is turned off in the integration options.
